notes.title: Early Access Build 3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][i]A holy quack rings through the Universe, the construction of a new arena is now complete[/i] [/b]

[h1]New Map: School[/h1] 
[list]
[*]A new map is now available for testing. Travel to Weebulu's homeworld and discover why he's such a great guy.
[/list]

[h1]New Level Ingredient: Teleporter[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Use it to gain speed or throw enemies off your tail. You can find it at School. Other maps may receive a set of teleporters in future updates

[/list]

[h1]UI: A new iteration of the HUD and scoreboard have been implemented to reduce screen clutter. Expect more changes to the HUD in future updates[/h1]
[list]


[*]The ball despawn bar now moves with the ball and players (when the ball is held) instead of being locked to the top of the screen

[*]Team score has been moved and integrated into defender zones

[*]The speedometer has been moved from the HUD to the scoreboard

[*]The UI that appears when a team scores has been updated to improve clarity

[*] Other minor UI changes


[/list]

[h1]Misc:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Controllers now wait for input before being assigned to a player slot
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][i]The Duck Lords have spoken, and a new patch has submerged from the depths[/i] [/b]

[h1]General:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Reduced the amount of points required to max the speedometer from 10 to 8

[*]Character trails have been modified to make tracking your character easier

[*]Additional visual feedback has been added when picking up and while holding the ball
[/list]

[h1]Misc:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Added compatibility with more controllers
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented game resolution from being changed while using a controller

[*]Fixed a bug that prevented achievement progress from saving
[/list]
